name: Taisho Pharmaceutical
verdict: Taisho Pharmaceutical is the operating subsidiary of Taisho Pharmaceutical Holdings, taken private in 2024 by the founding Uehara family through its vehicle Otemon. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Japanese family-owned pharmaceutical company (Lipovitan D); private since the April 2024 Uehara-family management buyout, no state or fund in the chain → none. Front-of-shirt sponsor ('リポビタンD') and Japan Rugby top partner per the JRFU. RWC 2027 Official Supplier as LipovitanD (rugbyworldcup.com/2027/en/partners); also a Global Partner of New Zealand Rugby (allblacks.com/partners).
